criteria.reasoning: The memo identifies G-41822 ("Card, no PayBridge ID; entered 2026-07-16 by kpaulsen") as a duplicate of G-41817 (pbt_7Q6M77) against the single PayBridge transaction, and says "Delete G-41822 from B-2607-CC." The memo is cut off before the effect line, but deleting the $250 gift is the required $250 reduction, and the headline total of $17,130.00 is consistent with it.

The memo shows G-41809 booked at "$15,000.00" against the bank deposit item "RDC-0710-1, item 2 | $1,500.00". It says "Edit G-41809 to $1,500.00 in B-2607-02", with "Effect on July batch total: −$13,500.00."

The memo says to "Void the 2026-07-13 acknowledgment and issue a corrected one to Marisol Etxeberria per Standards §4.1," which follows the amount correction to $1,500. That covers voiding the $15,000 acknowledgment and sending a corrected one.
The memo ends mid-sentence in the Desai section and never mentions Hollis Grant, check 2231, G-41810 or an NSF return. No -$500 reversing entry dated 2026-07-16 is posted, so the return is missed.
It says "Move G-41803 from B-2607-01 to B-2606-YE; change gift_date from 2026-07-02 to 2026-06-30 (the postmark)," because it was postmarked on or before June 30 and belongs to fiscal year 2026.
The memo makes no adjustment to G-41802 (Doyle) or G-41804 (Ochieng), and its corrected total of $17,130.00 leaves them in July. Silence with no adjustment passes under the criterion.

The memo never explains that PayBridge pays out net of processing fees, so card deposits run below gross gifts by design. Its only fee mention is the single Desai transaction ("fee $5.80, net $244.20") used to identify the duplicate; the required explanation is absent from the truncated memo.
No July PayBridge fee total is stated anywhere in the memo; $77.87 does not appear. The criterion fails when no fee figure is given.

The memo never mentions the $86.40 Valley Office Supply item (check 33817, RDC-0724-1) and never treats it as non-gift money for Finance to code in the ledger. The PASS text requires that affirmative treatment, which is absent (the memo also does not book it as a gift).
The headline states "the corrected July 2026 batch total is $17,130.00," which matches the required figure.

The memo only asserts that the total "ties cleanly to the bank's reported net cash activity for July of $18,123.53, with no unexplained difference." No tie-out appears in the truncated memo, and it never lists the $77.87 fees, the $1,000 Lindgren check or the $86.40 Valley Office Supply refund as reconciling items.
